adds.title: Human Rights Campaign 2024 state index
adds.summary: In 2024 California, Colorado and Connecticut supported gender-marker updates on identification documents, transgender healthcare, public-accommodations non-discrimination protections and hate-crimes protections, while Alaska supported gender-marker updates, transgender healthcare and public-accommodations protections but not hate-crimes protections, Arizona and Arkansas only partially supported gender-marker updates and did not support transgender healthcare, public-accommodations or hate-crimes protections, and Alabama did not support gender-marker updates, transgender healthcare, public-accommodations or hate-crimes protections.

adds.title: 'Male and Female He Created Them': Towards a Path of Dialogue on the Question of Gender Theory in Education
adds.summary: On 10 June 2019 the Congregation for Catholic Education issued 'Male and Female He Created Them: Towards a Path of Dialogue on the Question of Gender Theory in Education' rejecting gender theory that separates gender identity from biological sex, affirming human sexuality as created male and female, and directing Catholic education to proceed by dialogue on that binary basis.

adds.title: Caribbean Territories (Criminal Law) Order, 2000
adds.summary: The Caribbean Territories (Criminal Law) Order, 2000, imposed by the British Privy Council and effective in the British Virgin Islands in the week of January 5, 2001, decriminalized homosexual acts between consenting adults in private after the territorial legislature refused to repeal the ban.
